Service 02

Move-in / move-out

A clean handover for the space you’re leaving—or the one you’re about to call home.

Typical scope

Best when the rooms are empty.

Move cleans focus on the details that are easier to reach after belongings are out of the way.

Room-by-room resetAccessible surfaces, baseboards, floors and obvious dust buildup.
Kitchen & bathroom detailFixtures, cabinets exteriors and the high-use surfaces that shape a walkthrough.
Optional inside-cabinet scopeMention cupboards, drawers, appliances or other add-ons when requesting the quote.

The space should be empty of belongings and garbage unless a different scope is agreed in advance.

Service 05

Post-construction

The final clean after the tools, trades and building work are finished.

Typical scope

From worksite dust to finished space.

Post-construction jobs vary widely, so the quote starts with the size, site condition and handover priorities.

Fine-dust removalAccessible ledges, fixtures, baseboards, doors, surfaces and floors.
New kitchen & bathroom surfacesCabinet exteriors, counters, fixtures and protective-film residue discussed in scope.
Final presentation cleanA detail pass that helps the completed space look ready for use or handover.

Construction debris, hazardous material and active-trade cleanup are outside a standard final-clean scope and should be removed before the visit.
